verdict.rationale: Riskified documents its own maintained integrations: a Shopify app that automates void, restock, capture and cancellation emails, an SFCC (Agentforce Commerce) cartridge, and a Magento extension. For PSPs it has chargeback gateway integrations with Adyen, Stripe, Braintree and PayPal, so it is clearly more than a raw API. These are first-party docs only, and the PSP integrations cover only chargeback data, not order decisioning. Missing for 10: any BigCommerce integration, PSP integrations beyond chargeback handling, and independent or hands-on confirmation that these integrations are maintained.

support.subject: As an ops user, there are maintained integrations for my commerce stack — Shopify, Salesforce Commerce, BigCommerce, and the major PSPs — not just a raw API

citations.quote: Agentforce Commerce (formerly Salesforce Commerce Cloud / SFCC) fraud protection cartridge provides a structured integration process tailored to SFCC's platform architecture.
Once you have installed the Riskified app in your Shopify store, the integration process can begin.
Voids authorization on orders declined by Riskified. Enables automatic restocking of orders declined by Riskified. Captures funds for orders approved by Riskified.
A complete Magento integration includes two core components: Riskified Magento Extension ... Notification Endpoint

The Chargeback Gateway Integration (CGI) framework enables seamless connectivity with leading payment gateways, including Adyen, Stripe, Braintree, and PayPal, to automatically receive chargeback data without requiring custom API implementations.
